visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue long-sleeved crop top and a short black pleated skirt, stands in the foreground of a large, modern open-plan interior. She is holding a dark grey cordless vacuum cleaner, using its illuminated floor head to clean the light-colored wood-textured floor. The room is a high-ceilinged guesthouse space with exposed black industrial beams, featuring a large black L-shaped sofa, two round nested coffee tables on a grey geometric rug, and several bedroom alcoves with white linens in the background. (2) Through a series of rapid jump cuts synchronized to the music, the woman appears in different areas of the large room to showcase its scale. She is first seen in the far left background near a dining table and kitchen appliances, then instantly appears coming out of a bedroom on the right, and then stands in the middle background between two large beds. These shots emphasize the spacious and multi-functional nature of the Japanese guesthouse environment. (3) The woman reappears in the main living area, first standing with her arms spread wide toward the camera to signify the vastness of the space. She then transitions to sitting comfortably on the black leather sofa, looking directly at the camera. The scene concludes with her standing in front of the sofa performing a short, rhythmic dance step as the camera remains fixed in a wide-angle perspective, capturing the entirety of the living and sleeping quarters.
